Kul kainat sana-khwan hai, tamam haiywanat, sab nabatat us ki paki bayan karte hain, satwan asman, zameenien, un ki makhlooq aur har ek cheez us ki sitaish karne mein mashghool hai go tum un ki tasbeeh na samajh sako, Allah Haleem-o-Ghafoor hai. Us ke samne har koi past-o-ajiz-o-lachar hai, us ki muqarrar karda shariat aur us ke ahkam hikmat se pur hain. Haqiqi badshah jis ki malkiyat mein asman-o-zameen hain wahi hai, khalq mein mutasarrif wahi hai, zindagi maut usi ke qabze mein hai, wahi fana karta hai, wahi paida karta hai. Jise jo chahe inayat farmata hai, har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai, jo chahta hai ho jata hai, jo na chahe nahi ho sakta. 

Us ke baad ki ayat (Huwal-Awwalu wal-Akhiru waz-Zahiru wal-Batinu wa Huwa bi-kulli shai'in Aleem) (Al-Hadid: 3) woh ayat hai jis ki babat upar ki hadith mein guzra ke ek hazar ayton se afzal hai. 

Hazrat Abu Zumail Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se kehte hain ke mere dil mein ek khatka hai lekin zaban par lane ko ji nahi chahta, us par Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne muskura kar farmaya shayad kuch shak hoga jis se koi nahi bacha yahan tak ke Quran mein hai ayat (Fa-in kunta fi shakkin mimma anzala ilaika fas'alil-lazina yaqra'unal-kitaba min qablika la-qad ja'aka al-haqqu min rabbika fala takoonanna minal-mumtarin) (Yunus: 94), yani agar tu jo kuch teri taraf nazil kiya gaya hai us mein shak mein ho to tujh se pehle jo kitab padhte hain un se pooch le. Phir farmaya jab tere dil mein koi shak ho to is ayat ko padh liya kar (Huwal-Awwalu wal-Akhiru waz-Zahiru wal-Batinu wa Huwa bi-kulli shai'in Aleem) (Al-Hadid: 3). 

Is ayat ki tafsir mein das se upar upar aqwal hain. Bukhari farmate hain Yahya ka qaul hai ke zahir batin se murad az roo-e-ilm har cheez par zahir aur poshida hona hai. Yeh Yahya Ziyad Farra ke ladke hain un ki ek tasneef hai jis ka nam Ma'ani-ul-Quran hai. 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sone ke waqt yeh dua padha karte: 
"Aye Allah! Aye saton asmanon ke aur Arsh-e-Azeem ke Rab! Aye hamare aur har cheez ke Rab! Aye Taurat aur Injeel ke utaarne wale! Aye danon aur guthliyon ko ugane wale! Tere siva koi laayiqa-e-ibadat nahi, main teri panah mein ata hoon har us cheez ki burai se ke jis ki choti tere hath mein hai. Tu Awwal hai tujh se pehle kuch na tha, tu hi Akhir hai tere baad kuch nahi, tu Zahir hai tujh se unchi koi cheez nahi, tu Batin hai tujh se chhupi koi cheez nahi, hamare qarz ada kara de aur hamein faqiri se ghina de." 

Hazrat Abu Saleh apne muta'alliqeen ko yeh dua sikhate aur farmate sone ke waqt dahni karot par lait kar yeh dua padh liya karo, alfazon mein kuch her-pher hai. Mulahiza ho Muslim.

Abu Ya'la mein hai Hazrat Aisha farmati hain ke Huzoor ﷺ ke hukm se aap ka bistarah qibla-rukh bichhaya jata aap aa kar apne dahane haath par takiya laga kar aaram farmate, phir ahista ahista kuch padhte rehte lekin aakhir raat mein ba-aawaz buland yeh dua padhte (jo upar bayan hui) alfaaz mein kuch her-pher hai. 

Is ayat ki tafseer mein Jame Tirmizi mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ apne sahaba samet tashreef farma the ke ek baadal sar par aa gaya aap ne farmaya jaante ho yeh kya hai? Sahaba ne ba-adab jawab diya Allah aur uske Rasool zyada janne wale hain. Farmaya ise 'inan kehte hain yeh zameen ko sairab karne wale hain in logon par bhi yeh barsaye jate hain jo na Allah ke shukr guzaar hain na Allah ke pukarne wale. Phir poocha maloom hai tumhare upar kya hai? Unhon ne kaha Allah aur uska Rasool zyada ba-khabar hai, farmaya buland mehfooz chhat aur lipti hui mauj, jaante ho tum mein is mein kis qadar fasila hai? Wahi jawab mila, farmaya paanch sau saal ka raasta. 

Phir poocha jaante ho is ke upar kya hai? Sahaba ne phir apni la-ilmi un hi alfaaz mein zahir ki to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya is ke upar phir doosra aasman hai aur in dono aasmano mein bhi paanch sau saal ka fasila hai isi tarah aap ne saat aasman ginwaye aur har do mein itni hi doori bayan farmai. Phir sawal kar ke jawab sun kar farmaya is saatwein ke upar itne hi fasile se Arsh hai, phir poocha jaante ho tumhare neeche kya hai aur jawab wahi sun kar farmaya doosri zameen hai, phir sawal jawab ke baad farmaya is ke neeche doosri zameen hai aur dono zamino ke darmiyan paanch sau saal ka fasila hai, isi tarah saat zameenein isi fasile ke sath ek doosre ke neeche batayen. 

Phir farmaya is ki qasam jis ke haath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai agar tum koi rasi sab se neeche ki zameen ki taraf latkao to woh bhi Allah ke paas pahuchegi phir aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki, lekin yeh hadis ghareeb hai is ke raawi Hasan ka Ayyub Yunus aur Ali bin Zaid muhaddiseen ka qaul hai. Baaz ahl-e-ilm ne is hadis ki sharh mein kaha hai ke is se murad rasi ka Allah Ta'ala ke ilm qudrat aur ghalbe tak pahunchna hai (na ke zaat-e-Bari Ta'ala). Allah Ta'ala ka ilm us ki qudrat aur uska ghalba aur saltanat beshak har jagah hai lekin woh apni zaat se Arsh par hai jaise ke us ne apna yeh wasf apni Kitab mein khud bayan farmaya hai. 

Musnad Ahmad mein bhi yeh hadis hai aur is mein do do zamino ke darmiyan ka fasila saat sau saal ka bayan hua. Ibn Abi Hatim aur Bazzar mein bhi yeh hadis hai lekin Ibn Abi Hatim mein rasi latkane ka jumla nahi aur har do zameen ke darmiyan ki doori is mein bhi paanch sau saal ki bayan hui hai. Imam Bazzar ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke is riwayat ka raawi An-Hazrat ﷺ se baghair Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ke aur koi nahi. Ibn Jareer mein yeh hadis mursalan marwi hai yani Qatada farmate hain hum se yun zikr kiya gaya hai phir hadis bayan karte hain sahabi ka naam nahi lete.

Mumkin hai yehi theek ho, Wallahu A'lam, Hazrat Abu Zar Ghafari R.A se Musnad-e-Bazzar aur Kitab-ul-Asma was-Sifat lil-Baihaqi mein yeh hadis marwi hai lekin iski isnad mein nazar hai aur matn mein ghurbat o nakarat hai, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Imam Ibn Jarir Ayat (Wa minal-ardi mithlahunna 65. (At-Talaq: 12) ki tafsir mein Hazrat Qatadah R.H ka qaul laye hain ke asman o zamin ke darmiyan chaar farishton ki mulaqat hui. Aapas mein pucha ke tum kahan se aa rahe ho? To ek ne kaha satween asman se mujhe Allah Azzawajal ne bheja hai aur maine Allah ko wahin chora hai. Dusre ne kaha satween zamin se mujhe Allah ne bheja tha aur Allah wahin tha, teesre ne kaha mere Rab ne mujhe mashriq se bheja hai jahan woh tha, chothe ne kaha mujhe maghrib se Allah Ta'ala ne bheja hai aur main use wahin chor kar aa raha hoon. Lekin yeh riwayat bhi gharib hai balke aisa maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Qatadah R.H wali upar ki riwayat jo mursalan bayan hui hai mumkin hai woh bhi Hazrat Qatadah R.H ka apna qaul ho jaise yeh qaul khud Qatadah R.H ka apna hai. Wallahu A'lam.)

Kaha phir hum farmaya wah tum iman se kaise ruk sakte the, main tum mein zinda maujud hu, suno behtareen aur ajib tar imandaar woh log hain jo tumhare baad aayenge, sahifon mein likha dekhenge aur iman qubool karenge, Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein ayat (Alladhina yu'minuna bil-ghaibi wa yuqimus-salata wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 3) ki tafsir mein bhi hum aisi ahadith likh aaye hain, phir unhe Roz-e-Misaaq ka qaul-o-qarar yaad dilata hai jaise aur ayat mein hai (Wadhkuru ni'matallahi 'alaykum wa mithaqa-hulladhi wathaqakum bihi idh qultum sami'na wa ata'na wattaqullaha inna Allaha 'alimun bi dhatis-sudur) (Surah (Al-Ma'idah: 7), is se murad Rasulullah ﷺ se bai'at karna hai aur Imam Ibn Jarir farmate hain murad woh misaaq hai jo Hazrat Adam ki peeth se un se liya gaya tha, Mujahid ka bhi yahi mazhab hai Wallahu A'lam.

Woh Allah jo apne bande par roshan hujjatein aur behtareen dalail aur umda tar aayetein nazil farmata hai taake zulm-o-jahl ki ghanghor ghataon aur raaye qiyas ki badtareen andheriyon se tumhein nikal kar noorani aur roshan saaf aur seedhi rah-e-haq par la khada kar de. Imaan aur khairat ka hukm kar ke phir imaan ki raghbat dila kar aur yeh bayan farma kar ke imaan na lane ka ab koi uzr main ne baaki nahi rakha phir sadqat ki raghbat dilai, aur farmaya meri rah mein kharch karo aur faqiri se na daro, is liye ke jis ki rah mein tum kharch kar rahe ho woh zameen-o-asman ke khazano ka tanha malik hai, arsh-o-kursi usi ki hai aur woh tum se is khairat ke badle inaam ka wada kar chuka hai. Ibn Jarir mein hai: Hudaibiyah wale saal jab hum Huzoor ﷺ ke sath Usfan mein pohnche toh Aap ne farmaya: Aisay log bhi aayenge ke tum apne aamal ko un ke aamal ke muqable mein haqir samajhne lago ge. Jab Huzoor ﷺ ko is ka ilm hua to Aap ne farmaya mere sahaba ko mere liye chhor do, us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai agar tum Uhad ke ya kisi aur pahaar ke barabar sona kharch karo to bhi un ke aamal ko pohanch nahi sakte.

Is waqiah ka mukhtasar bayan oopar wali hadith mein hai.

Sahih hadith mein hai: Mere sahaba ko bura na kaho, us ki qasam jis ke qabza mein meri jaan hai, agar tum mein se koi Uhud pahad ke barabar sona kharch kare toh bhi un ke teen pao anaj ke sawab ko nahi pohnchega, balki dedh pao ko bhi na pohnchega.

Ibn Jarir mein hai: Hudaibiyah wale saal jab hum Huzoor ﷺ ke sath Usfan mein pohnche toh Aap ne farmaya: Aisay log bhi aayenge ke tum apne aamal ko un ke aamal ke muqable mein haqir samajhne lago ge. Hum ne kaha: Kya Quraishi? Farmaya: Nahi balki Yamani, nihayat naram-dil, nihayat khush-akhlaq, saada-mizaj. Hum ne kaha: Huzoor ﷺ phir kya woh hum se behtar honge? Aap ne jawab diya ke agar un mein se kisi ke paas Uhud pahad ke barabar sona bhi ho aur woh use rah-e-Khuda kharch kare toh tum mein se ek ke teen pao balki dedh pao anaj ki khairat ko bhi nahi pohnch sakta. Yaad rakho ke hum mein aur doosre tamam logon mein yahi farq hai. Phir Aap ne isi ayat (La yastawi) ki tilawat ki. Lekin yeh riwayat gharib hai.

Bukhari o Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri ki riwayat mein kharijiyon ke zikr mein hai ke tum apni namazein un ki namazon ke muqable aur apne roze un ke rozon ke muqable par haqir aur kamtar shumar karoge. Woh deen se is tarah nikal jayenge jis tarah teer shikar se.

Aap ne farmaya: Nahi, woh saada-mizaj, naram-dil, yahan wale hain aur Aap ne Yaman ki taraf apne hath se ishara kiya, phir farmaya: Woh Yamani log hain, iman toh Yaman walon ka iman hai aur hikmat Yaman walon ki hikmat hai. Huzur ﷺ Surah (Al-Takathur) parh kar farmane lage insan go kehta rehta hai yeh bhi mera maal hai yeh bhi mera maal hai halanki darasal insan ka maal woh hai jo kha liya pehn liya sadqa kar diya khaya hua fana ho gaya pehna hu purana ho kar barbad ho gaya, han rah-e-Allah diya hua ba-taur khazane ke jama raha (Muslim) aur jo baqi rahega woh to auron ka maal hai tu to ise jama kar ke chor jaane wala hai. Phir in hi dono baton ki targheeb dilata hai aur bahut bare ajr ka wada deta hai. Phir farmata hai tumhe iman se kaun si cheez rokti hai Rasul ﷺ tum mein maujud hain woh tumhe iman ki taraf bula rahe hain dalelein de rahe hain aur mojze dikha rahe hain, Sahih Bukhari ki sharh ke ibtedai hisse Kitab Al-Iman mein hum yeh hadith bayan kar aaye hain ki Huzur ﷺ ne pucha sab se zyada achhe iman wale tumhare nazdeek kaun hain? Kaha farishte, farmaya woh to Allah ke paas hi hain phir iman kyun na late? Kaha phir Anbiya farmaya un par to wahi aur Kalamullah utarta hai woh kaise iman na late? Kaha phir hum farmaya wah tum iman se kaise ruk sakte the, main tum mein zinda maujud hu, suno behtareen aur ajib tar imandaar woh log hain jo tumhare baad aayenge, sahifon mein likha dekhenge aur iman qubool karenge, Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein ayat (Alladhina yu'minuna bil-ghaibi wa yuqimus-salata wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 3) ki tafsir mein bhi hum aisi ahadith likh aaye hain, phir unhe Roz-e-Misaaq ka qaul-o-qarar yaad dilata hai jaise aur ayat mein hai (Wadhkuru ni'matallahi 'alaykum wa mithaqa-hulladhi wathaqakum bihi idh qultum sami'na wa ata'na wattaqullaha inna Allaha 'alimun bi dhatis-sudur) (Surah (Al-Ma'idah: 7), is se murad Rasulullah ﷺ se bai'at karna hai aur Imam Ibn Jarir farmate hain murad woh misaaq hai jo Hazrat Adam ki peeth se un se liya gaya tha, Mujahid ka bhi yahi mazhab hai Wallahu A'lam.

A'maal ke mutabiq badla diya jaye ga. Yahan bayan ho raha hai ke musalmanon ke naik amaal ke mutabiq unhein noor milega jo Qiyamat ke din un ke sath sath rahega. Hadrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) farmate hain un mein baaz ka noor paharon ke barabar hoga aur baaz ka khajuron ke darakhton ke barabar aur baaz ka khare insan ke qad ke barabar, sab se kam noor jis gunahgar momin ka hoga us ke pair ke anguthe par noor hoga jo kabhi roshan hota hoga aur kabhi bujh jata hoga (Ibn Jareer). 

Hadrat Qatada farmate hain hum se zikr kiya gaya hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ka irshad hai: Baaz momin aise bhi honge jin ka noor is qadr hoga ke jis qadr Madina se Aden door hai aur Abyan door hai aur Sana'a door hai. Baaz is se kam, baaz is se kam, yahan tak ke baaz woh bhi honge jin ke noor se sirf un ke dono qadmon ke paas hi ujala hoga. 

Hadrat Junada bin Abu Umayya farmate hain: Logo! Tumhare naam ma' waladiyat ke aur khas nishaniyon ke Allah ke han likhe hue hain, isi tarah tumhara har zahir batin amal bhi wahan likha hua hai, Qiyamat ke din naam le kar pukar kar keh diya jaye ga ke "Aey falan! Yeh tera noor hai aur aey falan! Tere liye koi noor hamare han nahi." Phir Aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat farmayi. 

Hadrat Dahhak farmate hain: Awwal awwal to har shakhs ko noor ata hoga lekin jab Pul-e-Sirat par jayenge to munafiqon ka noor bujh jaye ga, use dekh kar momin bhi darne lagenge ke aisa na ho hamara noor bhi bujh jaye, to Allah se duayein karenge ke "Ya Allah! Hamara noor hamare liye poora poora kar."

To ek shakhs ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Hadrat Nuh (A.S) se le kar Aap ki ummat tak ki tamam ummatein is maidan mein ikatthi hongi, un mein se Aap apni ummat ki shinakht kaise karenge? Aap ne farmaya: Baaz makhsoos nishaniyon ki wajah se meri ummat ke aza-e-wuzu chamak rahe honge, yeh wasf kisi aur ummat mein na hoga aur unhein un ke namah-e-amaal un ke dahne hathon mein diye jayenge aur un ke chehre chamak rahe honge aur un ka noor un ke aage aage chalta hoga aur un ki aulad un ke sath hi hogi. 

Dahhak farmate hain: Un ke dahne hath mein un ka amal-namah hoga jaise aur ayaton mein tashreeh hai. Un se kaha jaye ga ke aaj tumhein un jannaton ki بشارت (busharat) hai jin ke chappe chappe par chashme jari hain jahan se kabhi nikalna nahi, yeh zabardast kamyabi hai. 

Is ke baad ki ayat mein maidan-e-Qiyamat ke holnak, dil-shakan aur kapkapa dene wale waqiye ka bayan hai ke siwaye sachche iman aur khare aamal walon ke njaat kisi ko munh na dikhaye gi.

Salim bin Amir farmate hain hum ek janaze ke sath Bab-e-Damishq mein the jab janaze ki namaz ho chuki aur dafn ka kaam shuru hua toh Hazrat Abu Umamah Bahili R.A ne farmaya logo! Tum is duniya ki manzil mein aaj subh-o-sham kar rahe ho nekiyan buraiyan kar sakte ho iske baad ek aur manzil ki taraf tum sab koch karne wale ho woh manzil yahi qabr ki hai jo tanhai ka, andhere ka, keeron ka aur tangi aur tareeki wala ghar hai magar jiske liye Allah Ta'ala ise wus'at de de. Yahan se tum phir Maidan-e-Qiyamat ke mukhtalif maqamat par warid hoge. Ek jagah bahut se logon ke chehre safed ho jayenge aur bahut se logon ke siyah par jayenge, phir ek aur maidan mein jaoge jahan sakht andhera hoga wahan imandaron ko noor taqseem kiya jayega aur kafir-o-munafiq be-noor reh jayega, isi ka zikr ayat (Au zulumatin) al-kh, mein hai pas jis tarah ankhon wale ki basarat se andha koi nafa hasil nahi kar sakta munafiq-o-kafir imandar ke noor se kuch faida na utha sakenge. Toh munafiq imandaron se arzoo karenge ki is qadr aage na barh jao kuch to tehro jo hum bhi tumhare noor ke sahare chalein toh jis tarah yeh duniya mein musalmanon ke sath makr-o-fareeb karte the aaj un se kaha jayega ki laut jao aur noor talash kar lao yeh wapas noor ki taqseem ki jagah jayenge lekin wahan kuch na payenge, yahi Allah ka woh makr hai jiska bayan ayat (Innal munafiqina yukhadi'unallaha wa huwa khadi'uh

Huzoor ﷺ ka irshad hai ke Qiamat ke din logon ko un ki parda-poshi ke liye un ke namon se pukara jayega lekin Pul-e-Sirat par tameez ho jayegi, mominon ko noor milega aur munafiqon ko bhi milega lekin jab darmiyan mein pahunch jayenge munafiqon ka noor bujh jayega. Yeh mominon ko aawaz denge lekin us waqt khud momin khauf-zada ho rahe honge. Yeh woh waqt hoga ke har ek aapa-dhaapi mein hoga. Jis deewar ka yahan zikr hai yeh Jannat-o-Dozakh ke darmiyan hadd-e-faasil hogi. Isi ka zikr aayat (Wa bainahuma hijaabun wa ‘alal-a‘raafi rijaalun ya‘rifoona kullan bi-seemahum wa nada-‘ash-habal-jannati an salaamun ‘alaykum lam yadkhuloo-ha wa hum yatma‘oon) (7. Al-A‘raf: 46) mein hai.

Pas Jannat mein rehmat aur Jahannam mein azaab. Theek baat yahi hai lekin baaz ka qaul hai ke is se murad Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki deewar hai jo Jahannam ki wadi ke paas hogi. Ibn-e-Umar se marwi hai ke yeh deewar Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki sharqi deewar hai jis ke batin mein masjid waghera hai aur jis ke zahir mein wadi-e-Jahannam hai aur baaz buzurgon ne bhi yahi kaha hai, lekin yeh yaad rakhna chahiye ke un ka matlab yeh nahi ke bainahu yeh deewar is aayat mein murad hai balke is ka zikr bataur qurb ke ma’ni mein aayat ki tafseer mein un hazrat ne kar diya hai is liye ke Jannat aasmaanon mein A’la-Illiyeen mein hai aur Jahannam Asfal-us-Saafileen mein hai. Hazrat Ka’b Ahbar se marwi hai ke jis darwaze ka zikr is aayat mein hai is se murad Masjid ka Baab-ur-Rehmat hai, yeh Bani Israel ki riwayat hai jo hamare liye sanad nahi ban sakti.

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh deewar Qiamat ke din mominon aur munafiqon ke darmiyan alag-alag karne ke liye khadi ki jayegi. Momin to us ke darwaze mein se ja kar Jannat mein pahunch jayenge phir darwaza band ho jayega aur munafiq hairat-zada zulmat-o-azaab mein reh jayenge. Jaise ke duniya mein bhi yeh log kufr-o-jahalat, shak-o-hairat ke andheron mein the. Ab yeh yaad dilayenge ke dekho duniya mein hum tumhare sath the, jum’a jama’at ada karte the, Arafaat aur ghazwaat mein maujood rehte the, wajibat ada karte the. Imaan-dar kahenge haan baat to theek hai lekin apne kartoot to dekho, gunahon mein, nafsani khwahishon mein, Allah ki na-farmaniyon mein umr bhar tum lazzatein uthate rahe aur aaj tauba kar lenge, kal bad-amaliyon chhor denge isi mein rahe. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain ke yeh munafiq momino ke sath thay nikah byah majlis majma maut zeest mein shareek rahe. Ke khabardar un ka rang tum par na charh jaye. Asl-o-far' mein un se bilkul alag raho, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Rabi' bin Abu Amilah farmate hain Quran Hadith ki mithas to muslim hi hai lekin main ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood ؓ se ek bahut hi pyari aur meethi baat suni hai jo mujhe behad mahboob aur marghoub hai Aap ne farmaya jab Bani Israel ki ilahami kitab par kuch zamana guzar gaya to un logon ne kuch kitabein khud tasneef kar lin aur un mein woh masail likhe jo unhein pasand thay aur jo un ke apne zehen se unhon ne tarash liye thay, ab maze le le kar zibanein mor mor kar unhein parhne lage un mein se aksar masail Allah ki kitab ke khilaf thay jin jin ahkamon ke manne ko un ka ji na chahta tha unhon ne badal dale thay aur apni kitab ke mutabiq masail jama kar liye thay aur unhi par amil ban gaye, ab unhein soojhi ke aur logon ko bhi manwayen aur unhein bhi amada karein ke in hi hamari likhi hui kitabon ko shar'i kitabein samjhein aur madar-e-amal unhi par rakhein ab logon ko usi ki dawat dene lage aur zor pakarte gaye, yahan tak ke jo un ki in kitabon ko na manta use yeh satatay takleef dete marte peette balki qatal kar daltay, un mein ek shakhs Allah wale pure alim aur muttaqi thay unhon ne un ki taqat se aur ziyadati se mar'oub ho kar Kitabullah ko ek lateef cheez par likh kar ek narsinghe mein dal kar apni gardan mein ise dal liya, un logon ka shar-o-fasad roz-be-roz barhta ja raha tha yahan tak ke bahut se un logon ko jo Kitabullah par amil thay unhon ne qatal kardiya, phir aapas mein mashwara kiya ke dekho ke yoon ek ek ko kab tak qatal karte rahenge? Un ka bara alim aur hamari is kitab ko bilkul na manne wala tamam Bani Israel mein sab se barh kar Kitabullah ka amil falan alim hai ise pakro aur is se apni yeh rai qiyas ki kitab manwao agar woh maan lega to phir hamari chandi hi chandi hai aur agar woh na mane to ise qatal kardo phir tumhari is kitab ka mukhalif koi na rahega aur doosre log khwah-makhwah hamari in kitabon ko qubool kar lenge aur unhein manne lagenge, chunacha un rai qiyas walon ne Kitabullah ke alim-o-amil is buzurg ko pakarwa mangwaya aur is se kaha ke dekh hamari is kitab mein jo hai ise sab ko to manta hai ya nahi? Un par tera iman hai ya nahi? Us Allah tars Kitabullah ke manne wale alim ne kaha is mein tum ne kya likha hai? Zara mujhe sunao to, unhon ne sunaya aur kaha is ko to manta hai? Us buzurg ko apni jaan ka dar tha is liye jurrat ke sath yeh na keh saka ke nahi manta balki apne is narsinghe ki taraf ishara kar ke kaha mera is par iman hai woh samajh bethe ke is ka ishara hamari is kitab ki taraf hai.

Chanacha us ki eza-rasani se baaz rahe lekin taham us ke atwar-o-affaal se khatakte hi rahe yahan tak ke jab is ka inteqal hua toh unhon ne taftish shuru ki ke aisa na ho us ke paas Kitabullah aur deen ke sachhe masail ki koi kitab ho akhir woh narsingha un ke hath lag gaya parha toh us mein asli masail Kitabullah ke maujood thay ab baat banali ke hum ne toh kabhi yeh masail nahi sune aisi baatein hamare deen ki nahi chanacha zabardast fitna barpa ho gaya aur behtar groh ho gaye un sab mein behtar groh jo rasti par aur haq par tha woh tha jo us narsinghe wale masail par amil tha. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood ne yeh waqia bayan farma kar kaha logo tum mein se bhi jo baqi rahega woh aise hi umur ka moainah karega aur woh bilkul bebas hoga in buri kitabon ke mitane ki is mein qudrat na hogi, pas aise majboori aur bekasi ke waqt bhi us ka yeh farz toh zaroor hai ke Allah Ta'ala par yeh sabit kar de ke woh un sab ko bura janta hai. Imam Abu Jafar Tabari (Rahimahullah) ne bhi yeh riwayat naql ki hai ke Atris bin Arqoub Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ke paas aaye aur kahne lage ae Abu Abdullah jo shakhs bhalai ka hukm na kare aur burai se na roke woh halak hua aap ne farmaya halak woh hoga jo apne dil se achhai ko achhai na samjhe aur burai ko burai na jaane, phir aap ne Bani Israel ka yeh waqia bayan farmaya. Phir irshad-e-bari lekin ab yahan bilkul alag kar diye gaye. Surah Muddathir ki aayton mein hai ke musalman mujrimon se unhein jahannam mein dekh kar poochhenge ke akhir tum yahan kaise phans gaye aur woh apne bad-amaal ginwayenge. Toh yaad rahe ke yeh sawal sirf ba-toor dant-dupat ke aur unhein sharminda karne ke liye hoga warna haqeeqat-e-haal se musalman khoob aagah honge. Phir yeh jaise wahan farmaya tha ke kisi ki sifarish unhein nafa na degi, yahan farmaya aaj un se fadiya na liya jayega go zameen bhar kar sona dein qabool na kiya jayega na munafiqon se na kafiron se un ka marja-o-mawa jahannam hai wahi un ke layak hai aur zahir hai ke woh bad-tareen jagah hai.)

Tumhare naam ma' waladiyat ke aur khas nishaniyon ke Allah ke han likhe hue hain, isi tarah tumhara har zahir batin amal bhi wahan likha hua hai, Qiyamat ke din naam le kar pukar kar keh diya jaye ga ke "Aey falan! Huzoor ﷺ ka irshad hai ke Qiamat ke din logon ko un ki parda-poshi ke liye un ke namon se pukara jayega lekin Pul-e-Sirat par tameez ho jayegi, mominon ko noor milega aur munafiqon ko bhi milega lekin jab darmiyan mein pahunch jayenge munafiqon ka noor bujh jayega. Al-A‘raf: 46) mein hai.

Pas Jannat mein rehmat aur Jahannam mein azaab. Theek baat yahi hai lekin baaz ka qaul hai ke is se murad Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki deewar hai jo Jahannam ki wadi ke paas hogi. Momin to us ke darwaze mein se ja kar Jannat mein pahunch jayenge phir darwaza band ho jayega aur munafiq hairat-zada zulmat-o-azaab mein reh jayenge. Jaise ke duniya mein bhi yeh log kufr-o-jahalat, shak-o-hairat ke andheron mein the. Ab yeh yaad dilayenge ke dekho duniya mein hum tumhare sath the, jum’a jama’at ada karte the, Arafaat aur ghazwaat mein maujood rehte the, wajibat ada karte the. Intezaar mein hi umr guzari di ke dekhen musalmanon ka nateeja kya hota hai? Aur tumhein yeh bhi yaqeen na aaya ke Qiamat aayegi bhi ya nahi? Aur phir is aarzu mein rahe ke agar aayegi phir to hum zaroor bakhsh diye jayenge aur marte dam tak Allah ki taraf yaqeen khuloos ke sath jhukne ki taufeeq muyassar na aayi aur Allah ke sath tumhein dhokebaaz Shaitan ne dhoke mein hi rakha. Yahan tak ke aaj tum Jahannam wasil ho gaye.

Toh munafiq imandaron se arzoo karenge ki is qadr aage na barh jao kuch to tehro jo hum bhi tumhare noor ke sahare chalein toh jis tarah yeh duniya mein musalmanon ke sath makr-o-fareeb karte the aaj un se kaha jayega ki laut jao aur noor talash kar lao yeh wapas noor ki taqseem ki jagah jayenge lekin wahan kuch na payenge, yahi Allah ka woh makr hai jiska bayan ayat (Innal munafiqina yukhadi'unallaha wa huwa khadi'uh

Huzoor ﷺ ka irshad hai ke Qiamat ke din logon ko un ki parda-poshi ke liye un ke namon se pukara jayega lekin Pul-e-Sirat par tameez ho jayegi, mominon ko noor milega aur munafiqon ko bhi milega lekin jab darmiyan mein pahunch jayenge munafiqon ka noor bujh jayega. Yeh mominon ko aawaz denge lekin us waqt khud momin khauf-zada ho rahe honge. Yeh woh waqt hoga ke har ek aapa-dhaapi mein hoga. Jis deewar ka yahan zikr hai yeh Jannat-o-Dozakh ke darmiyan hadd-e-faasil hogi. Isi ka zikr aayat (Wa bainahuma hijaabun wa ‘alal-a‘raafi rijaalun ya‘rifoona kullan bi-seemahum wa nada-‘ash-habal-jannati an salaamun ‘alaykum lam yadkhuloo-ha wa hum yatma‘oon) (7. Al-A‘raf: 46) mein hai.

Pas Jannat mein rehmat aur Jahannam mein azaab. Theek baat yahi hai lekin baaz ka qaul hai ke is se murad Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki deewar hai jo Jahannam ki wadi ke paas hogi. Ibn-e-Umar se marwi hai ke yeh deewar Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki sharqi deewar hai jis ke batin mein masjid waghera hai aur jis ke zahir mein wadi-e-Jahannam hai aur baaz buzurgon ne bhi yahi kaha hai, lekin yeh yaad rakhna chahiye ke un ka matlab yeh nahi ke bainahu yeh deewar is aayat mein murad hai balke is ka zikr bataur qurb ke ma’ni mein aayat ki tafseer mein un hazrat ne kar diya hai is liye ke Jannat aasmaanon mein A’la-Illiyeen mein hai aur Jahannam Asfal-us-Saafileen mein hai. Hazrat Ka’b Ahbar se marwi hai ke jis darwaze ka zikr is aayat mein hai is se murad Masjid ka Baab-ur-Rehmat hai, yeh Bani Israel ki riwayat hai jo hamare liye sanad nahi ban sakti.

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh deewar Qiamat ke din mominon aur munafiqon ke darmiyan alag-alag karne ke liye khadi ki jayegi. Momin to us ke darwaze mein se ja kar Jannat mein pahunch jayenge phir darwaza band ho jayega aur munafiq hairat-zada zulmat-o-azaab mein reh jayenge. Jaise ke duniya mein bhi yeh log kufr-o-jahalat, shak-o-hairat ke andheron mein the. Ab yeh yaad dilayenge ke dekho duniya mein hum tumhare sath the, jum’a jama’at ada karte the, Arafaat aur ghazwaat mein maujood rehte the, wajibat ada karte the. Imaan-dar kahenge haan baat to theek hai lekin apne kartoot to dekho, gunahon mein, nafsani khwahishon mein, Allah ki na-farmaniyon mein umr bhar tum lazzatein uthate rahe aur aaj tauba kar lenge, kal bad-amaliyon chhor denge isi mein rahe. Intezaar mein hi umr guzari di ke dekhen musalmanon ka nateeja kya hota hai? Aur tumhein yeh bhi yaqeen na aaya ke Qiamat aayegi bhi ya nahi? Aur phir is aarzu mein rahe ke agar aayegi phir to hum zaroor bakhsh diye jayenge aur marte dam tak Allah ki taraf yaqeen khuloos ke sath jhukne ki taufeeq muyassar na aayi aur Allah ke sath tumhein dhokebaaz Shaitan ne dhoke mein hi rakha. Yahan tak ke aaj tum Jahannam wasil ho gaye.

Matlab yeh hai ke jismon se to tum hamare sath the lekin dil aur niyat se hamare sath na the balke hairat-o-shak mein hi pare rahe, riyakari mein rahe aur dil laga kar yaad-e-Ilahi karna bhi tumhein naseeb na hua.

Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain ke yeh munafiq momino ke sath thay nikah byah majlis majma maut zeest mein shareek rahe. Ke khabardar un ka rang tum par na charh jaye. Asl-o-far' mein un se bilkul alag raho, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Rabi' bin Abu Amilah farmate hain Quran Hadith ki mithas to muslim hi hai lekin main ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood ؓ se ek bahut hi pyari aur meethi baat suni hai jo mujhe behad mahboob aur marghoub hai Aap ne farmaya jab Bani Israel ki ilahami kitab par kuch zamana guzar gaya to un logon ne kuch kitabein khud tasneef kar lin aur un mein woh masail likhe jo unhein pasand thay aur jo un ke apne zehen se unhon ne tarash liye thay, ab maze le le kar zibanein mor mor kar unhein parhne lage un mein se aksar masail Allah ki kitab ke khilaf thay jin jin ahkamon ke manne ko un ka ji na chahta tha unhon ne badal dale thay aur apni kitab ke mutabiq masail jama kar liye thay aur unhi par amil ban gaye, ab unhein soojhi ke aur logon ko bhi manwayen aur unhein bhi amada karein ke in hi hamari likhi hui kitabon ko shar'i kitabein samjhein aur madar-e-amal unhi par rakhein ab logon ko usi ki dawat dene lage aur zor pakarte gaye, yahan tak ke jo un ki in kitabon ko na manta use yeh satatay takleef dete marte peette balki qatal kar daltay, un mein ek shakhs Allah wale pure alim aur muttaqi thay unhon ne un ki taqat se aur ziyadati se mar'oub ho kar Kitabullah ko ek lateef cheez par likh kar ek narsinghe mein dal kar apni gardan mein ise dal liya, un logon ka shar-o-fasad roz-be-roz barhta ja raha tha yahan tak ke bahut se un logon ko jo Kitabullah par amil thay unhon ne qatal kardiya, phir aapas mein mashwara kiya ke dekho ke yoon ek ek ko kab tak qatal karte rahenge? Un ka bara alim aur hamari is kitab ko bilkul na manne wala tamam Bani Israel mein sab se barh kar Kitabullah ka amil falan alim hai ise pakro aur is se apni yeh rai qiyas ki kitab manwao agar woh maan lega to phir hamari chandi hi chandi hai aur agar woh na mane to ise qatal kardo phir tumhari is kitab ka mukhalif koi na rahega aur doosre log khwah-makhwah hamari in kitabon ko qubool kar lenge aur unhein manne lagenge, chunacha un rai qiyas walon ne Kitabullah ke alim-o-amil is buzurg ko pakarwa mangwaya aur is se kaha ke dekh hamari is kitab mein jo hai ise sab ko to manta hai ya nahi? Un par tera iman hai ya nahi? Us Allah tars Kitabullah ke manne wale alim ne kaha is mein tum ne kya likha hai? Zara mujhe sunao to, unhon ne sunaya aur kaha is ko to manta hai? Us buzurg ko apni jaan ka dar tha is liye jurrat ke sath yeh na keh saka ke nahi manta balki apne is narsinghe ki taraf ishara kar ke kaha mera is par iman hai woh samajh bethe ke is ka ishara hamari is kitab ki taraf hai.

Chanacha us ki eza-rasani se baaz rahe lekin taham us ke atwar-o-affaal se khatakte hi rahe yahan tak ke jab is ka inteqal hua toh unhon ne taftish shuru ki ke aisa na ho us ke paas Kitabullah aur deen ke sachhe masail ki koi kitab ho akhir woh narsingha un ke hath lag gaya parha toh us mein asli masail Kitabullah ke maujood thay ab baat banali ke hum ne toh kabhi yeh masail nahi sune aisi baatein hamare deen ki nahi chanacha zabardast fitna barpa ho gaya aur behtar groh ho gaye un sab mein behtar groh jo rasti par aur haq par tha woh tha jo us narsinghe wale masail par amil tha. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood ne yeh waqia bayan farma kar kaha logo tum mein se bhi jo baqi rahega woh aise hi umur ka moainah karega aur woh bilkul bebas hoga in buri kitabon ke mitane ki is mein qudrat na hogi, pas aise majboori aur bekasi ke waqt bhi us ka yeh farz toh zaroor hai ke Allah Ta'ala par yeh sabit kar de ke woh un sab ko bura janta hai. Imam Abu Jafar Tabari (Rahimahullah) ne bhi yeh riwayat naql ki hai ke Atris bin Arqoub Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ke paas aaye aur kahne lage ae Abu Abdullah jo shakhs bhalai ka hukm na kare aur burai se na roke woh halak hua aap ne farmaya halak woh hoga jo apne dil se achhai ko achhai na samjhe aur burai ko burai na jaane, phir aap ne Bani Israel ka yeh waqia bayan farmaya. Phir irshad-e-bari lekin ab yahan bilkul alag kar diye gaye. Surah Muddathir ki aayton mein hai ke musalman mujrimon se unhein jahannam mein dekh kar poochhenge ke akhir tum yahan kaise phans gaye aur woh apne bad-amaal ginwayenge. Toh yaad rahe ke yeh sawal sirf ba-toor dant-dupat ke aur unhein sharminda karne ke liye hoga warna haqeeqat-e-haal se musalman khoob aagah honge. Phir yeh jaise wahan farmaya tha ke kisi ki sifarish unhein nafa na degi, yahan farmaya aaj un se fadiya na liya jayega go zameen bhar kar sona dein qabool na kiya jayega na munafiqon se na kafiron se un ka marja-o-mawa jahannam hai wahi un ke layak hai aur zahir hai ke woh bad-tareen jagah hai.)

Imaan Walon Se Sawal
Parwardigar-e-Alam farmata hai kya momino ke liye ab tak woh waqt nahi aaya ke Zikr-e-Illahi, waz-o-naseehat, ayaat-e-Qurani aur ahadees-e-Nabwi sun kar un ke dil mom ho jayein? Sunein aur maanein, ahkaam baja layein, mamnooat se parhez karein. 
Ibne Abbas farmaate hain Quran nazil hote hi terah saal ka arsa na guzra tha ke musalmano ke dilon ko is taraf na jhukne ki der ki shikayat ki gayi, Ibne Masood farmaate hain chaar hi saal guzre the jo hamein yeh itab hua (Muslim). 
Ashab-e-Rasool par malaal hua ke Huzoor ﷺ se kehte hain Hazrat kuch baat to bayaan farmayein, pas yeh aayat utarti hai: 
(NAHNU NAQUSSU ‘ALAIKA AHSANAL-QASASI BIMA ‘Auhayna ‘ILAIKA HAZAL-QUR’ANA WA ‘IN KUNTA MIN QABLIHI LAMINAL-GHAFILIN) (Yusuf: 3) 
Ek martaba kuch dinon baad yehi arz karte hain to aayat utarti hai: 
(ALLAHU NAZZALA AHSANAL-HADIETHI KETABAN MUTASHABIHAN MATHANIYA TAQSHA’IRRU MINHU JULUDUL-LADHINA YAKHSHAUNA RABBAHUM THUMMA TALIYNU JULUDUHUM WA QULUBUHUM ‘ILA ZIKR-ILLAHI ZALIKA HUDA-LLAHI YAHDIY BIHI MAN YASHA’U WA MAN YUDLILIL-LLAHU FAMA LAHU MIN HADIN) (Az-Zumar: 23) 
Phir ek arsa baad yehi kehte hain to yeh aayat (Alam Ya’an) utarti hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmaate hain sab se pehle khair jo meri ummat se uth jayegi woh khushoo hoga. 
Phir farmaya tum Yahood-o-Nasara ki tarah na ho jana jinhone Kitabullah ko badal diya, thode thode mol par use frocht kar diya. Pas Kitabullah ko pas-e-pusht daal kar raaye-o-qiyas ke peeche pad gaye aur az-khud ijaad karda aqwal ko manne lag gaye aur Allah ke deen mein doosron ki taqleed karne lage, apne ulma aur darwesho ki be-sanad baatein deen mein daal lein, in bad-amaliyon ki saza mein Allah ne un ke dil sakht kar diye, kitni hi Allah ki baatein kyun na sunao un ke dil naram nahi hote, koi waz-o-naseehat un par asar nahi karta, koi wada-o-waeed un ke dil Allah ki taraf mod nahi sakta, balki un mein ke aksar-o-bishtar fasiq aur khule bad-kaar ban gaye, dil ke khote aur aamal ke bhi kache, jaise aur aayat mein hai: 
(FABIMA NAQDINIHIM MITHAQAHUM LA’ANNAHUM WA JA’ALNA QULUBUHUM QASIYAH) (Al-Ma'idah: 13) 
In ki bad-ahdi ki wajah se hum ne un par laanat nazil ki aur un ke dil sakht kar diye, yeh kalmaat ko apni jagah se tahreef kar dete hain aur hamari naseehat ko bhula dete hain, yaani un ke dil fasid ho gaye, Allah ki baatein badalne lag gaye, nekiyan chod dein, buraiyon mein munhamik ho gaye. 
Isi liye Rabb-e-Alamain is ummat ko mutanabbah kar raha hai ke jaan rakho murda zameen ko Allah zinda kar deta hai, is mein is amr ki taraf ishara hai ke sakht dilon ke baad bhi Allah unhein naram karne par qadir hai, gumrahiyon ki teh mein utar jaane ke baad bhi Allah raah-e-raast par laata hai, jis tarah baarish khushk zameen ko tar kar deti hai, usi tarah Kitabullah murda dilon ko zinda kar deti hai.

Dilon mein jabke ghata-top andhera chha gaya ho Kitabullah ki roshni use daftatan munawwar kar deti hai, Allah ki wahi ke qufl ki kunji hai. Sachha hadi wahi hai, gumrahi ke baad rah par lane wala, jo chahe karne wala, hikmat-o-adl wala, latif-o-khair wala, kibr-o-jalal wala, bulandi-o-ulu wala wahi hai.

Sadaqa-o-khairat karne walon ke liye ajr-o-sawab. Faqir, miskeen, mohtajon aur hajat-mandon ko khalis Allah ki marzi ki justuju mein jo log apne halal maal naik neeyati se Allah ki raah mein sadaqa dete hain un ke badle bahut kuch barha charha kar Allah Ta'ala unhe ata farmayega. Das das gune aur is se bhi zyada saat saat sau tak balke is se bhi sawa un ke sawab besahab hain un ke ajr bahut bare hain. Allah Rasool par iman rakhne wale hi Siddiq-o-Shaheed hain, in dono ausaf ke mustahiq sirf ba-iman log hain, ba'z hazraat ne Ash-Shuhada ko alag jumla mana hai, gharz teen qismein huin, musaddiqeen, siddiqeen, shuhada. Jaise aur riwayat mein hai Allah aur Us ke Rasool ka itaat-guzar inaam yafta logon ke sath hai jo Nabi, Siddiq, Shaheed aur Saleh log hain, pas Siddiq-o-Shaheed mein yahan bhi farq kiya gaya hai jis se maloom hota hai ke yeh do qism ke log hain, Siddiq ka darja Shaheed se yaqinan bara hai. Huzoor ﷺ ka irshad hai jannati log apne se upar ke bala-khane walon ko is tarah dekhenge jaise chamakte hue mashriqi ya maghribi sitare ko tum asman ke kinare par dekhte ho, logon ne kaha yeh darje to sirf Ambiya ke honge, Aap ne farmaya haan qasam hai us ki jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai yeh woh log hain jo Allah par iman laaye aur Rasoolon ki tasdeeq ki (Bukhari, Muslim). Ek ghareeb hadees se yeh bhi maloom hota hai ke Shaheed aur Siddiq dono wasf is ayat mein usi momin ke hain. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain meri ummat ke momin Shaheed hain, phir Aap ne usi ayat ki tilawat ki. Hazrat Amr bin Maimoon ka qoul hai yeh dono un dono ungliyon ki tarah Qayamat ke din aayenge, Bukhari aur Muslim ki hadees mein hai shaheedon ke roohein sabz rang parindon ke qaalib mein hongi jannat mein jahan chahein khati peeti phirenge aur raat ko qandeelon mein sahara lenge un ke Rabb ne un ki taraf ek baar dekha aur pucha tum kya chahte ho? Unhon ne kaha yeh ke tu hamein duniya mein dobara bhej taake hum phir teri raah mein jihad karein aur shahadat hasil karein, Allah ne jawab diya yeh to main faisla kar chuka hoon ke koi laut kar phir duniya mein nahi jayega, phir farmata hai ke unhe ajr-o-noor milega jo noor un ke samne rahega aur un ke aamal ke mutabiq hoga. Musnad Ahmad ki hadees mein hai shaheedon ki chaar qismein hain. 1. Woh pakke iman wala momin jo dushman-e-Allah se bhar gaya aur larta raha yahan tak ke tukre tukre ho gaya, is ka woh darja hai ke ahl-e-mahshar is tarah sar utha utha kar us ki taraf dekhenge aur yeh farmate hue Aap ne apna sar is qadar buland kiya ke topi niche gir gayi aur is hadees ke rawi Hazrat Umar ne bhi ise bayan karne ke waqt itna hi apna sar buland kiya ke Aap ki topi bhi zameen par ja pari. 2. Dusra woh iman dar nikla jihad mein lekin dil mein jurrat kam hai ke yakayak ek teer aa laga aur rooh parwaaz kar gayi, yeh dusre darje ka shaheed jannati hai.

Teesra woh jis ke bhale bure aamal thay lekin Rab ne use pasand farma liya aur maidan-e-jihad ke haathon shahadat naseeb hui teesre darje mein hain. Chautha woh jis ke gunah bohat zyada hain jihad mein nikla aur Allah ne shahadat naseeb farma kar apne paas bulwa liya. In naik logon ka anjam bayan kar ke ab bad logon ka nateja bayan kiya ke yeh jahannami hain.

Musnad Ahmad ki hadees mein hai shaheedon ki chaar qismein hain. 1. Woh pakke iman wala momin jo dushman-e-Allah se bhar gaya aur larta raha yahan tak ke tukre tukre ho gaya, is ka woh darja hai ke ahl-e-mahshar is tarah sar utha utha kar us ki taraf dekhenge aur yeh farmate hue Aap ne apna sar is qadar buland kiya ke topi niche gir gayi aur is hadees ke rawi Hazrat Umar ne bhi ise bayan karne ke waqt itna hi apna sar buland kiya ke Aap ki topi bhi zameen par ja pari. 2. Dusra woh iman dar nikla jihad mein lekin dil mein jurrat kam hai ke yakayak ek teer aa laga aur rooh parwaaz kar gayi, yeh dusre darje ka shaheed jannati hai.

Chautha woh jis ke gunah bohat zyada hain jihad mein nikla aur Allah ne shahadat naseeb farma kar apne paas bulwa liya. In naik logon ka anjam bayan kar ke ab bad logon ka nateja bayan kiya ke yeh jahannami hain.

Allah Ta'ala apni us qudrat ki khabar de raha hai jo us ne makhluqaat ki paidaish se pehle hi apni makhluq ki taqdir muqarrar ki thi, farmaya ke zameen ke jis hisse mein koi burai aaye ya jis kisi shakhs ki jaan par kuch aapade use yaqeen rakhna chahiye ke khalq ki paidaish se pehle hai, lekin zyada theek baat yeh hai ke makhluq ki paidaish se pehle hai, Imam Hasan se is ayat ki baabat sawal hua to farmane lage SubhanAllah har museebat jo asmaan o zameen mein hai woh nafs ki paidaish se pehle hi Rabb ki kitab mein maujood hai is mein kya shak hai? Zameen ki museebaton se murad khushksali, qahat waghera hai aur janoon ki museebat dard dukh aur beemari hai, jis kisi ko koi kharash lagti hai ya laghzish-e-pa se koi takleef pahunchti hai ya kisi sakht mehnat se paseena aa jata hai yeh sab us ke gunahon ki wajah se hai aur abhi to bohat se gunah hain jinhe woh Ghafoor-o-Rahim Allah bakhsh deta hai, yeh ayat behtareen aur bohat aala daleel hai Qadriya ki tardeed mein jis ka khayal hai ke sabiq ilm koi cheez nahi Allah unhe zaleel kare. 

Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Allah Ta'ala ne taqdir muqarrar asmaan o zameen ki paidaish se pachaas hazaar baras pehle ki aur riwayat mein hai is ka arsh pani par tha (Tirmizi). 

Phir farmata hai kamon ke wajood mein aane se pehle un ka andaaza kar lena, un ke hone ka ilm hasil kar lena aur ise likh dena Allah par kuch mushkil nahi. Wahi to un ka paida karne wala hai. Jis ka muheet ilm hone wali, ho rahi, ho chuki, hogi tamam cheezon ko shamil hai. 

Phir irshad hota hai hum ne tumhe yeh khabar is liye di hai ke tum yaqeen rakho ke jo tumhe pahuncha woh hargiz kisi soorat talne wala na tha, pas museebat ke waqt sabr-o-shukr tahammul-o-sabit-qadami mazboot dili aur roohani taqat tum mein maujood rahe, haaye waaye besabri aur bezabti tum se door rahe jaz-o-faz-a tum par chha na jaye tum itminan se raho ke yeh takleef to aane wali thi hi, isi tarah agar maal daulat ghalba waghera mil jaye to us waqt aape se bahar na ho jao ise atiya-e-Ilahi mano takabbur aur ghuroor tum mein na aa jaye aisa na ho ke daulat-o-maal waghera ke nashe mein phool jao aur Allah ko bhool jao is liye ke us waqt bhi hamari yeh taleem tumhare saamne hogi ke yeh mere dast-o-baazu ka meri aql-o-hosh ka nateeja nahi balki Allah ki ata hai. 

Aik qiraat is ki aatakum hai doosri atakum hai aur dono mein talazum hai, isi liye irshad hota hai ke apne jee mein apne aap ko bada samajhne wale doosron par fakir karne wale Allah ke dushman hain, Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka farman hai ke ranj-o-rahat khushi-o-gham to har shakhs par aata hai khushi ko shukr mein aur gham ko sabr mein guzaar do. 

Phir irshad hota hai ke yeh log khud bhi bakheel aur khilaf-e-sharih kaam karne wale hain aur doosron ko bhi yahi bura rasta batate hain. Jo shakhs Allah ki hukm-bardari se hat jaye woh Allah ka kuch nahi bigade ga kyunke woh tamam makhluq se beniyaz hai aur har tarah saza aur hamd hai.

Jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne farmaya, yani agar tum aur tamam ruye zameen ke insan kafir ho jayein toh bhi Allah ka kuch nahi bigaad sakte, Allah sari makhlooq se ghani hai aur mustahiq-e-hamd hai.

Allah Azzawajal farmata hai ke hum ne apne paigambaron ko zahir hujjatein aur bharpoor dalael de kar duniya mein mabouth farmaya, phir sath hi unhein kitab bhi di jo khari aur saaf sachi hai aur adl-o-haq diya jis se har aql-mand insaan un ki baaton ke qabool kar lene par fitratan majboor ho jata hai, haan bimaar rai wale aur khilaf-e-aql wale is se mehroom reh jate hain, jaise aur jagah hai ayat: (Afaman kana 'ala bayyinatin min rabbihi wa yatluhu shahidun minhu wa min qablihi kitabu musa imaman wa rahmah 11-Hud: 17) jo shakhs apne Rabb ki taraf se daleel par ho aur sath hi us ke shahid bhi hon. 

Ek aur jagah hai Allah ki yeh fitrat hai jis par makhlooq ko us ne paida kiya hai aur farmata hai aasmaan ko us ne buland kiya aur mizan rakh di, pas yahan farman hai yeh is liye ke log haq-o-adl par qayam ho jayen, yaani ittibaa-e-rasool karne lagen, Amr-e-Rasool ﷺ baja layen. Rasool ﷺ hi ki tamam baaton ko haq samjhein kyunke is ke siva haq kisi aur ka kalam nahi. Jaise farman hai ayat: (Wa tammat kalimatu rabbika sidqan wa adlan la mubaddila likalimatihi wa huwas sami'ul 'alim 6-Al-An'am: 115) tere Rabb ka kalma jo apni khabron mein sacha aur apne ahkaam mein adl wala hai poora ho chuka. 

Yahi wajah hai ke jab iman dar jannaton mein pahunch jayenge, Allah ki naimaton se mala maal ho jayenge, to kahenge Allah ka shukar hai jis ne hamein hidayat di agar us ki hidayat na hoti to hum is rah nahi lag sakte the, hamare Rabb ke Rasool ﷺ hamare paas haq laye the. 

Phir farmata hai hum ne munkirin-e-haq ki sarkobi ke liye loha banaya hai, yaani awwalan to kitab-o-rasool aur haq se hujjat qayam ki, phir tedhe dil walon ki kaji nikalne ke liye lohe ko paida kar diya taake us ke hathiyar banein aur Allah dost hazraat Allah ke dushmanon ke dil ka kanta nikal dein, yahi namoona Huzoor ﷺ ki zindagi mein bilkul ayan nazar aata hai ke Makkah Sharif ke terah saal mushrikin ko samjhane, tauheed-o-sunnat ki dawat dene, un ke aqaid ki islaah karne mein guzare. Pas lohe se ladaai ke hathiyar bante hain jaise talwar, naize, churiyan, teez zarhein waghera aur logon ke liye is ke alawa bhi bohat se faiday hain.

Phir farmaya taake Allah jaan le ke in hathiyaron ke uthane se Allah Rasul ki madad karne ka naik irada kis ka hai? Allah quwwat aur ghalba wala hai, us ke deen ki jo madad kare woh us ki madad karta hai, darasal apne deen ko wohi qawi karta hai us ne jehad toh sirf apne bando ki aazmayish ke liye muqarrar farmaya hai warna ghalba o nusrat toh usi ki taraf se hai.

Hazrat Nuh aur Hazrat Ibrahim ki Fazilat

Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) aur Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ki is fazilat ko dekhiye ke Hazrat Nuh ke baad se lekar Hazrat Ibrahim tak jitne paighambar aaye sab aap hi ki nasl se aaye aur phir Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke baad jitne nabi aur rasool aaye sab ke sab aap hi ki nasl se hue jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa laqad arsalna Nuhan wa Ibrahima wa ja'alna fi zurriyatihima an-nubuwwata wal-kitaba faminhum muhtadin wa kasirun minhum fasiqoon) (Al-Hadid: 26). Yahan tak ke Bani Israel ke aakhri paighambar Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (Alaihis Salam) ne Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khushkhabri sunai. 

Pas Nuh aur Ibrahim Salawatullahi Alaihima ke baad barabar rasoolon ka silsila raha Hazrat Isa tak jinhein Injeel mili aur jin ki tabe farman ummat rahamdil aur narm mizaj waqie hui, khashiyat-e-Ilahi aur rahmat-e-khalq ke paak ausaf se mutasif. Phir Nasraniyon ki ek bid'at ka zikr hai jo unki shariat mein to na thi lekin unho ne khud apni taraf se ise ijad kar liya tha, iske baad ke jumle ke do matlab bayan kiye gaye hain ek to yeh ke unka maqsad naik tha ke Allah ki raza-joi ke liye yeh tareeqa nikala tha. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Qatadah waghera ka yahi qaul hai. 

Doosra matlab yeh bayan kiya gaya hai ke humne unpar ise wajib na kiya tha haan humne unpar sirf Allah ki raza-joi wajib ki thi. Phir farmata hai yeh ise bhi nibha na sake jaisa chahiye tha waisa is par bhi na jame, pas dohri kharabi aayi ek apni taraf se ek nayi baat deen-e-Allah mein ijad karne ki doosre is par bhi qaim na rehne ki, yaani jise woh khud qurb-e-Allah ka zariya apne zehn se samajh baithe the bil-akhir is par bhi poore na utre.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Masoud ko pukara, aap ne labbaik kaha, aap ne farmaya: Suno! Bani Israel ke tehattar (73) groh ho gaye, jin mein se teen ne najaat paayi. Pehle firqah ne toh Bani Israel ki gumraahi dekh kar un ki hidayat ke liye apni jaanein hatheliyon par rakh kar un ke baron ko tabligh shuru ki, lekin aakhir woh log jidal-o-qital par utar aaye aur baadshah aur umara ne, jo is tabligh se bahut ghabraate thay, un par lashkar-kashi ki aur unhein qatal bhi kiya, qaid bhi kiya. Un logon ne toh najaat haasil kar li.

Phir doosri jama'at khadi hui, un mein muqabla ki taqat toh na thi, taham apne deen ki quwwat se sarkashon aur baadshahon ke darbar mein haq-goi shuru ki aur Allah ke sachche deen aur Hazrat Isa ke asli maslak ki taraf unhein dawat dene lage. In badnaseebon ne unhein qatal bhi karwaya, aaron se bhi chira aur aag mein bhi jalaya, jise is jama'at ne sabr-o-shukr ke sath bardasht kiya aur najaat haasil ki.

Phir teesri jama'at uthi, yeh un se bhi ziyada kamzor thay, un mein taqat na thi ke asli deen ke ahkaam ki tabligh un zalimon mein karein, is liye unhon ne apne deen ka bachao isi mein samjha ke jangalon mein nikal jaayen aur pahardon par chadh jaayen, ibadat mein mashghool ho jaayen aur duniya ko tark kar dein. Inhi ka zikr rahbaniyat wali aayat mein hai.

Yahi hadith doosri sanad se bhi marwi hai, is mein tehattar firqon ka bayan hai aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke ajr nahi milega jo mujh par iman laayein aur meri tasdeeq karein aur un mein se aksar fasiq hain, aise hain jo mujhe jhutlayein aur mera khilaf karein.

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Bani Israel ke baadshahon ne Hazrat Isa ke baad Torah-o-Injeel mein tabdiliyan kar leen, lekin ek jama'at iman par qaim rahi aur asli Torah-o-Injeel un ke hathon mein rahi, jise woh tilawat kiya karte thay. Ek martaba un logon ne (jinhon ne Kitabullah mein radd-o-badal kar liya tha) apne baadshahon se un sachche mominon ki shikayat ki ke yeh log Kitabullah keh kar jis kitab ko padhte hain, us mein toh hamein gaaliyan likhi hain, us mein likha hua hai: "Jo koi Allah ki nazil karda kitab ke mutabiq hukm na kare, woh kafir hai," aur isi tarah ki bahut si aayetein hain. Phir yeh log hamare amaal par bhi aib-giri karte rehte hain. Pas aap unhein darbar mein bulwaiye aur unhein majboor kijiye ke ya toh woh isi tarah padhein jis tarah hum padhte hain aur waisa hi aqeedah iman rakhein jaisa hamara hai, warna unhein badtareen ibrat-nak saza dijiye.

Chuna-che in sachche musalmanon ko darbar mein bulwaya gaya aur un se kaha gaya ke ya toh hamari islah karda kitab padha karo aur tumhare apne hathon mein jo ilhami kitabein hain unhein chhod do, warna jaan se hath dho lo aur qatal-gah ki taraf qadam badhao. Is par un pak-bazon ki ek jama'at ne kaha ke tum hamein satao nahi, tum oonchi imarat bana do, hamein wahan pahuncha do aur dori chhadi de do, hamara khana-peena us mein dal diya karo, hum ooper se ghasit liya karenge, neeche utrenge hi nahi aur tum mein aayenge hi nahi.

Ek jama'at ne kaha: Suno! Hum yahan se hijrat kar jaate hain, jangalon aur pahardon mein nikal jaate hain, tumhari baadshahat ki sarzameen se bahar ho jaate hain, chashmon, nehron, nadiyon, nalon aur talabon se janwaro ki tarah munh laga kar pani piya karenge aur jo phool-paat mil jaayenge un par guzarah kar lenge.

Us ke baad agar tum hamein apne mulk mein dekh lo to beshak gardan ura dena, teesri jamaat ne kaha hamein apni abadi ke ek taraf kuch zameen de do aur wahan hisaar khinch do wahin hum kuwein khod lenge aur kheti kar liya karenge tum mein hargiz na aayenge. Chunke is Allah parast jamaat se un logon ki qaribi rishtadaariyan thin is liye yeh darkhwastein منظور kar li gayin aur yeh log apne apne thikaane chale gaye, lekin un ke sath baaz aur log bhi lag gaye jinhe darasal ilm-o-imaan na tha taqleedan sath ho liye, un ke bare mein yeh aayat (Wa rahbaniyyatan ibtada'uha ma katabnaha 'alayhim illa ibtigha'a ridwan-illah fama ra'awha haqqa ri'ayatiha 27) (Al-Hadid: 27) nazil hui, pas jab Allah Ta'ala ne Huzoor-e-Anwar ﷺ ko mab'uth farmaya us waqt un mein se bahut kam log reh gaye the Aap ki bisrat ki khabar sunte hi khanqahon wale apni khanqahon se aur jangalon wale apne jangalon se aur hisaar wale apne hisaaron se nikal khare hue Aap ki khidmat mein hazir hue Aap par iman laye, Aap ki tasdeeq ki jis ka zikr is aayat mein hai (Ya ayyuhal-lazina amanu bi-rasulihi yu'tikum kiflayni min rahmatihi wa yaj'al lakum nuran tamshuna bihi) alakh, yaani iman walo Allah se daro aur us ke Rasul par iman lao tumhe Allah apni رحمت ka dohra hissa dega (yaani Hazrat Isa par iman lane ka aur phir Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ par iman lane ka) aur tumhe noor dega jis ki roshni mein tum chalo phiro (yaani Quran-o-Sunnat) taake Ahl-e-Kitab jaan lein (jo tum jaise hain) ke Allah ke kisi fazl ka unhe ikhtiyar nahi aur sara fazl Allah ke hath hai jise chahe deta hai aur Allah bare fazl ka malik hai. Yeh siyaq ghareeb hai aur un dono pichli ayaton ki tafsir is aayat ke baad hi aa rahi hai, Insha'Allah Ta'ala Abu Yala mein hai ke log Hazrat Anas bin Malik ؓ ke paas Madina mein Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ؒ ki khilafat ke zamane mein aaye, Aap us waqt amir-e-Madina the jab yeh aaye us waqt Hazrat Anas namaz ada kar rahe the aur bahut halki namaz parh rahe the jaise musafir ki namaz ho ya us ke qareeb qareeb jab salam phera to logon ne Aap se pucha ke kya aap ne farz namaz parhi ya nafal? Farmaya farz aur yehi namaz Rasulullah ﷺ ki thi, main ne apne khayal se apni yaad barabar to us mein koi khata nahi ki, haan agar kuch bhool gaya hoon to us ki babat nahi keh sakta. Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke apni janon par sakhti na karo warna tum par sakhti ki jayegi, ek qoum ne apni janon par sakhti ki aur un par bhi sakhti ki gayi pas un ki baqiyyah khanqahon mein aur gharon mein ab bhi dekh lo tark-e-duniya ki hi wohi sakhti thi jise Allah ne un par wajib nahi kiya tha. Doosre din hum logon ne kaha aaiye sawariyon par chalein aur dekhein aur ibrat hasil karein. Hazrat Anas ne farmaya bahut acha hum sawar ho kar chale aur kai ek bastiyan dekhein jo bilkul ujad gayi thin aur makanat oundhe pare hue the to hum ne kaha in shahron se aap waqif hain?

Farmaya khoob achchi tarah balki un ke bashindon se bhi unhein sarkashi aur hasad ne halak kiya. Hasad nekiyon ke noor ko bujha deta hai aur sarkashi uski tasdeeq ya takzeeb karti hai. Aankh ka bhi zina hai haath aur qadam aur zaban ka bhi zina hai aur sharmgah use sach sabit karti hai ya jhutlati hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain har Nabi ke liye rahbaniyat thi aur meri Ummat ki rahbaniyat Allah Azzawajal ki raah mein jihad karna hai. Ek shakhs Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ke paas aata hai aur kehta hai ke mujhe kuch wasiyat kijiye. Aap ne farmaya tum ne mujh se woh sawal kiya jo maine Rasool Allah ﷺ se kiya tha. Main tujhe wasiyat karta hoon Allah se darte rehne ki, yehi tamam nekiyon ka sar hai aur tu jihad ko lazim pakde reh yehi Islam ki rahbaniyat hai aur zikr-e-Allah aur tilawat-e-Quran par mudawamat kar. Wahi aasman mein, zameen mein teri rahat-o-rooh hai aur teri yaad hai. Yeh riwayat Musnad Ahmad mein hai wallahu ta'ala aalam.

Chunke is Allah parast jamaat se un logon ki qaribi rishtadaariyan thin is liye yeh darkhwastein منظور kar li gayin aur yeh log apne apne thikaane chale gaye, lekin un ke sath baaz aur log bhi lag gaye jinhe darasal ilm-o-imaan na tha taqleedan sath ho liye, un ke bare mein yeh aayat (Wa rahbaniyyatan ibtada'uha ma katabnaha 'alayhim illa ibtigha'a ridwan-illah fama ra'awha haqqa ri'ayatiha 27) (Al-Hadid: 27) nazil hui, pas jab Allah Ta'ala ne Huzoor-e-Anwar ﷺ ko mab'uth farmaya us waqt un mein se bahut kam log reh gaye the Aap ki bisrat ki khabar sunte hi khanqahon wale apni khanqahon se aur jangalon wale apne jangalon se aur hisaar wale apne hisaaron se nikal khare hue Aap ki khidmat mein hazir hue Aap par iman laye, Aap ki tasdeeq ki jis ka zikr is aayat mein hai (Ya ayyuhal-lazina amanu bi-rasulihi yu'tikum kiflayni min rahmatihi wa yaj'al lakum nuran tamshuna bihi) alakh, yaani iman walo Allah se daro aur us ke Rasul par iman lao tumhe Allah apni رحمت ka dohra hissa dega (yaani Hazrat Isa par iman lane ka aur phir Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ par iman lane ka) aur tumhe noor dega jis ki roshni mein tum chalo phiro (yaani Quran-o-Sunnat) taake Ahl-e-Kitab jaan lein (jo tum jaise hain) ke Allah ke kisi fazl ka unhe ikhtiyar nahi aur sara fazl Allah ke hath hai jise chahe deta hai aur Allah bare fazl ka malik hai. Yeh siyaq ghareeb hai aur un dono pichli ayaton ki tafsir is aayat ke baad hi aa rahi hai, Insha'Allah Ta'ala Abu Yala mein hai ke log Hazrat Anas bin Malik ؓ ke paas Madina mein Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ؒ ki khilafat ke zamane mein aaye, Aap us waqt amir-e-Madina the jab yeh aaye us waqt Hazrat Anas namaz ada kar rahe the aur bahut halki namaz parh rahe the jaise musafir ki namaz ho ya us ke qareeb qareeb jab salam phera to logon ne Aap se pucha ke kya aap ne farz namaz parhi ya nafal? Farmaya farz aur yehi namaz Rasulullah ﷺ ki thi, main ne apne khayal se apni yaad barabar to us mein koi khata nahi ki, haan agar kuch bhool gaya hoon to us ki babat nahi keh sakta. Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke apni janon par sakhti na karo warna tum par sakhti ki jayegi, ek qoum ne apni janon par sakhti ki aur un par bhi sakhti ki gayi pas un ki baqiyyah khanqahon mein aur gharon mein ab bhi dekh lo tark-e-duniya ki hi wohi sakhti thi jise Allah ne un par wajib nahi kiya tha. Doosre din hum logon ne kaha aaiye sawariyon par chalein aur dekhein aur ibrat hasil karein. Hazrat Anas ne farmaya bahut acha hum sawar ho kar chale aur kai ek bastiyan dekhein jo bilkul ujad gayi thin aur makanat oundhe pare hue the to hum ne kaha in shahron se aap waqif hain?

Farmaya khoob achchi tarah balki un ke bashindon se bhi unhein sarkashi aur hasad ne halak kiya. Hasad nekiyon ke noor ko bujha deta hai aur sarkashi uski tasdeeq ya takzeeb karti hai. Aankh ka bhi zina hai haath aur qadam aur zaban ka bhi zina hai aur sharmgah use sach sabit karti hai ya jhutlati hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain har Nabi ke liye rahbaniyat thi aur meri Ummat ki rahbaniyat Allah Azzawajal ki raah mein jihad karna hai. Ek shakhs Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ke paas aata hai aur kehta hai ke mujhe kuch wasiyat kijiye. Aap ne farmaya tum ne mujh se woh sawal kiya jo maine Rasool Allah ﷺ se kiya tha. Main tujhe wasiyat karta hoon Allah se darte rehne ki, yehi tamam nekiyon ka sar hai aur tu jihad ko lazim pakde reh yehi Islam ki rahbaniyat hai aur zikr-e-Allah aur tilawat-e-Quran par mudawamat kar. Wahi aasman mein, zameen mein teri rahat-o-rooh hai aur teri yaad hai. Yeh riwayat Musnad Ahmad mein hai wallahu ta'ala aalam.

Musalmanon aur Yahood-o-Nasara ki misaal is se pehle ki aayat mein bayan ho chuki hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jin mominon ka yahan zikr hai is se murad Ahl-e-Kitab ke momin hain aur unhein dohra ajar milega jaise ke Surah Qasas ki aayat mein hai aur jaise ke ek hadith mein aaya hai ke teen shakhson ko Allah Ta'ala dohra ajar dega: ek woh Ahl-e-Kitab jo apne Nabi par imaan laya phir mujh par bhi imaan laya use dohra ajar hai, aur woh ghulam jo apne aaqa ki tabedari kare aur Allah ka haq bhi ada kare use bhi do do ajar hain, aur woh shakhs jo apni laundi ko adab sikhaye aur bahut achha adab sikhaye yani shar'i adab phir use azaad kar de aur nikah kar de woh bhi dohre ajar ka mustahiq hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain jab Ahl-e-Kitab is dohre ajar par fakhr karne lage to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat is ummat ke haq mein nazil farmayi. Pas unhein dohre ajar ke baad noor-e-hidayat dene ka bhi wada kiya aur maghfirat ka bhi, pas noor aur maghfirat unhein zyada mili (Ibn-e-Jarir). Isi mazmoon ki ek aayat (Yaa-ayyuhallazina aamanu in tattaqullaha yaj'al lakum furqanaw wa yukaffir 'ankum sayyi-aatikum wa yaghfir lakum, wallahu zul-fazlil 'azeem) (Surah (Al-Anfal: 29) hai, yani ae imaan walo agar tum Allah se darte rahe to woh tumhare liye furqan karega aur tum se tumhari buraiyan door kar dega aur tumhein maaf farma dega, Allah bade fazl wala hai. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne yahudiyon ke ek bahut bade aalim se daryaft farmaya ke tumhein ek neki par zyada se zyada kis qadar fazilat milti hai? Usne kaha saarhe teen sau tak, aap ne Allah ka shukr kiya aur farmaya hamein tum se dohra ajar mila hai. Hazrat Saeed ne ise bayan farma kar yahi aayat padhi aur farmaya isi tarah Jumma ka dohra ajar hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai: Tumhari aur Yahood-o-Nasara ki misaal is shakhs jaisi hai jis ne chand mazdoor kisi kaam par lagane chahe aur elaan kiya ke koi hai jo mujh se ek qirat le aur subah ki namaz se le kar aadhe din tak kaam kare? Pas Yahood tayyar ho gaye, us ne phir kaha zuhar se asr tak ab jo kaam kare use main ek qirat doonga, is par Nasrani tayyar hue, kaam kiya aur ujrat li. Us ne phir kaha ab asr se maghrib tak jo kaam kare main use do qirat doonga, pas woh tum Musalman ho. Is par Yahood-o-Nasara bahut bigre aur kehne lage kaam hum ne zyada kiya aur daam unhein zyada mile, hamein kam diya gaya. To unhein jawab mila ke main ne tumhara koi haq to nahin mara? Unhon ne kaha aisa to nahin hua.

Jawab mila ke phir yeh mera fazal hai jise chahoon do, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai musalmanon aur yahood nasraniyon ki misal us shakhs ki tarah hai jis ne chand logon ko kaam par lagaya ujrat thehrali aur kaha din bhar kaam karke keh diya ke ab humein zaroorat nahi jo hum ne kiya us ki ujrat bhi nahi chahte aur ab hum kaam bhi nahi karenge, us ne unhein samjhaya bhi ke aisa na karo kaam poora karo aur mazdoori le jao lekin unhon ne saaf inkaar kardiya aur kaam adhoora chhod kar ujrat liye baghair chalte bane, us ne aur mazdoor lagaye aur kaha ke baaki kaam shaam tak tum poora karo aur poore din ki mazdoori mein tumhein doonga, yeh kaam par lage, lekin asr ke waqt yeh bhi kaam se hat gaye aur keh diya ke ab hum se nahi ho sakta humein aap ki ujrat nahi chahiye us ne unhein bhi samjhaya bhi ke dekho ab din baaki hi kya reh gaya hai tum kaam poora karo aur ujrat le jao lekin yeh na maane aur chale gaye, us ne phir auron ko bulaya aur kaha lo tum maghrib tak kaam karo aur din bhar ki mazdoori le jao chunacha unhon ne maghrib tak kaam kiya aur un dono jamaaton ki ujrat bhi yehi le gaye, pas yeh hai un ki misal aur us noor ki misal jise unhon ne qubool kiya. Phir farmata hai yeh is liye ke Ahl-e-Kitab yaqeen kar lein ke Allah jise de yeh us ke lautane ki aur jise na de usse dene ki kuch bhi qudrat nahi rakhte aur us baat ko bhi woh jaan lein ke fazl-o-karam ka malik sirf wahi Parwardigar hai, us ke fazl ka koi andaaza ya hisab nahi laga sakta. Imam Ibn Jareer Rahimahullah farmata hain ayat (la'lla ya'lamu) ka maana (li ya'lamu) hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A ki qirat mein (li kay ya'lamu) hai, isi tarah Hazrat Atta bin Abdullah Rahimahullah aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair Rahimahullah se bhi yehi qirat marwi hai. Gharz yeh hai ke kalaam-e-arab mein la sila ke liye aata hai jo kalaam ke awwal aakhir mein aa jata hai aur wahan se inkaar murad nahi hota jaise ayat (Ma mana'aka alla tasjuda iz amartuka) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 12) mein hai aur ayat (Wa ma yush'irukum annaha iza ja'at la yu'minoon) (Surah (Al-An'am: 109) mein aur ayat (Wa haramun 'ala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarji'oon) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 95) mein. Alhamdulillah Surah Hadid ki tafsir khatam hui. Allah Ta'ala ka hazar hazar shukr hai ke is sattaiswein paray ki tafsir bhi khatam hui. Allah Ta'ala qubool farmaye aur humein apne pak kalaam ki sahih samajh de aur us par amal ki taufeeq de. Mere meherban Allah! Mere aajiz haathon se is pak tafsir ko poori kara, isse mukammal matboo'ah mujhe dikha de, maqbooliyat ata farma aur is par humein amal naseeb farma. Ae dilon ke bhed se aagah Allah! Meri aajizanah iltamas hai ke mere namah-e-aamal mein isse sabt farma aur mere tamam gunahon ka kaffara isse kar de aur iske padhne walon par rahem farma aur unke dil mein daal ke woh mere liye bhi rahem ki dua karein. Ya Rabb apne sachche deen ki aur apne ghulamon ki tajeed kar aur apne Nabi ke kalaam ko sab ke kalaamon par ghalib rakh.
